title: Graph composition through the open leg
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring and use ordinary small-etale module sheaves and their unbounded derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Let f:X→Y and v′:X′→X be separated finite-type morphisms between Noetherian schemes, v′ etale, and supply compactifications of f, v′ and v′f. Fix c=(j,p), a compactification of f. Let j′:X′→Z′ be open, b:Z′→c.Z separated etale, and v′j=j′b, with Z′ Noetherian. Put r=v′j, choose any compactification e of r, and supply a compactification of rp. Let S denote exact derived etale sum extension, J and J′ derived open extension, and P=Rp_*. Set a:J′S_b→S_v′J to the conjugate composite-left-adjoint comparison of the exact inverse-image square. Set s:J′S_b→S_r to the conjugate of the exact inverse-image compositor U_r→U_b U_j′. Let d_v′:F_v′→S_v′ be the canonical graph comparison transported to the chosen model [lem-asd-compact-support-graph-derived-isomorphism]. Let l:S_v′F_f→F_rp be d_v′ inverse, then the specified compact-support compositor, then congruence for v′f=rp [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons]. Let k:S_rP→F_rp be the inverse canonical graph comparison for e whiskered by P, the functor associator, the canonical proper direct-image compositor, and the model-to-chosen comparison for e.postcomp p. For every derived M on X′, t_c.hom at S_v′M followed by l.hom at M equals P(a.inv at M), followed by P(s.hom at M), followed by k.hom at M. Only the etale-first composition occurs; no proper/etale interchange or second compact-support composition is asserted.

proof.text: Expand the etale-first compact-support composition on the tower e over c using the every-tower formula. Its etale model is e.restrict. Replace its comparison by the canonical graph-derived comparison; compare the terminal model c.comp e with e.postcomp p under the equality v′f = (v′c.i)p.

On each lift summand, extending by zero from the graph of v′ and then along the open c.i yields the same section as extension from the graph of r=v′c.i. Both sections vanish on the complement. Sheaf gluing and the universal property of sum sheafification identify these maps. Transpose through the sum/open composite adjunctions: the comparison of factorizations is precisely a inverse followed by s.

Apply the sheaf equality degreewise and compose with the derived direct-image units. The graph-derived component formula identifies the maps on every homotopy representative. Naturality of the units and the unit equation for derived direct-image composition give equality there; homotopy localization gives equality on all inputs. Graph refinement coherence and normalized proper-refinement comparison cancel the auxiliary tower, leaving the explicit k built from e and p.

theorem etaleGraph_open_tower
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X X' Y Z' : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian X'] [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian Z']
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {v' : X' ⟶ X}
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [Etale v'] [IsSeparated v'] [QuasiCompact v']
    [HasCompactification f] [HasCompactification v']
    [HasCompactification (v' ≫ f)] [QuasiCompact (v' ≫ f)]
    (c : Compactification f) (j' : X' ⟶ Z') [IsOpenImmersion j']
    (b : Z' ⟶ c.Z) [Etale b] [IsSeparated b]
    (osq : CommSq v' j' c.i b)
    (e : Compactification (v' ≫ c.i))
    [HasCompactification ((v' ≫ c.i) ≫ c.g)]
    (M : DerivedCategoryModule A X') :
    let r := v' ≫ c.i
    let p := c.g
    let va := derivedEtaleLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v' inferInstance
    let ba := derivedEtaleLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) b inferInstance
    let ja := derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i
    let j'a := derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j'
    let a := (conjugateIsoEquiv (va.comp ja) (j'a.comp ba)).symm
      (exactDerivedSquareUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) osq.flip)
    let s := (conjugateIsoEquiv
      (derivedEtaleLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) r inferInstance)
      (j'a.comp ba)).symm
      (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso
        (upperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j' b r osq.w) ≪≫
        Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso _ _)
    let dv' := (rightDerivedLowerShriekIso A
      (HasCompactification.compactification v')).symm ≪≫
      canonicalEtaleCompactSupportComparison A v' (HasCompactification.compactification v')
    let w : v' ≫ f = r ≫ p :=
      (congrArg (fun h : X ⟶ Y ↦ v' ≫ h) c.comm).trans (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    let l := Functor.isoWhiskerRight dv'.symm
      (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f) ≪≫
      unboundedEtaleLowerShriekCompIso A v' f ≪≫ unboundedEtaleLowerShriekCongr A w
    let k := Functor.isoWhiskerRight
      (canonicalEtaleCompactSupportComparison A r e).symm
      (rightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p) ≪≫
      Functor.associator _ _ _ ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft
        (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e.i).mapDerivedCategory
        (rightDerivedLowerStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e.g p) ≪≫
      rightDerivedLowerShriekIso A (e.postcomp p)
    (rightDerivedLowerShriekIso A c).hom.app
        ((etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v' inferInstance).mapDerivedCategory.obj M) ≫
      l.hom.app M =
      (rightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p).map (a.inv.app M) ≫
      (rightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p).map (s.hom.app M) ≫ k.hom.app M
